prompts.master: Top-down broad organic burning oily fuel pool, realistic painted orange/gold flames, embers, no smoke; transparent RGBA.
prompts.fuel-phases: Four phases of the exact reference pool in a 2x2 grid; stable center, footprint, scale, camera and palette; vary internal flames and embers.
prompts.connector-phases: Four horizontal burning-fuel stream phases matching master, stacked rows; continuous thick hot bed, soft ends, natural flames, no pools; transparent RGBA.
prompts.smoke-phases: Four 2x2 phases of matching volumetric charcoal/brown smoke, faint orange illumination, soft translucent edges; no flame or backdrop.

processing: Common alpha trim per family, Lanczos resize and raster-only composite. Wall dense bed uses central connector crop under three connector segments and four fuel pools. No procedural fire or smoke.
animation: 8 fps combat clock; reduced motion freezes fuel/wall and reduces smoke opacity

beam.processing: Alpha crop of existing generated Ultimate raster, no redesign. Dedicated renderer frame avoids legacy generated override padding.
